propositions: Multiple regression-oracle test scanners independently walk source trees and parse .py files redundantly, with AST parsing consuming 75-80% of scan time and causing measurable gate delays under coverage runs.

A shared memoized parse helper cached per process root path can eliminate redundant parsing across scanners within a single xdist worker, reducing second+ scanner latency from 6.64s to 2.89s and 5.07s to 1.91s.

The shared helper must maintain byte-identical parse results by using ast.parse(source, filename=str(path)) and strict UTF-8 decoding, and must exclude scanners that walk synthetic or tmp_path roots with potentially unparseable files.
After migrating 38 whole-tree scanners across unit/store/commands/rebar_reconciler/contracts and excluding planted-root scanners, all tests pass unchanged with identical selection and assertions.
